title: Load only the Execute contract into workers
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- drivers && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pointer_integrity

truths: skills/bee-swarming/references/execute.md holds the Execute (worker) section and the Tester contract, and skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md keeps one pointer line to it

packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md tells the native worker to read skills/bee-swarming/references/execute.md instead of loading the whole bee-swarming skill, and the golden native prompt test is updated to the new line
worker-cell.md is named as the one home of the Result form; swarming-reference.md replaces its Worker Prompt Template and Result form copies with pointers
the bee-worker and bee-comb agent templates no longer repeat rules the rendered prompt carries, and bee-forager, bee-scout and bee-elder drop the registry and reservation line
